svg.title: Shlok Bam ID badge with verified numbers
svg.desc: A lanyard ID badge with a portrait, barcode and metal clasp that drops in and swings gently, beside six dated figures: 17 plus projects completed, 3 patents as co-inventor, CGPA 9.01 at the 6th semester, 90 plus Google Arcade badges, 3 certifications, and 48 public GitHub repositories as of 17 October 2026.
